title: Pretraining Representation Lottery Determines Fine-tuning Generalization
abstract: arXiv:2611.28777v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large scale pretraining (PT) followed by fine-tuning (FT) is the central paradigm of modern deep learning, yet how PT shapes FT generalization remains poorly understood. We use a synthetic setup in which the ground-truth concept geometry of entities is known, as a controlled testbed to study how representational geometry affects model behavior and how PT representations determine FT generalization. We first show that models differing only in training seed can closely match in PT loss yet vary substantially in FT generalization. We hypothesize that a representational lottery underlies this phenomenon: the random seed dependent geometry formed during PT determines what FT can reach. We confirm this causally. First, injecting the ground-truth concept geometry into the model yields near-ceiling FT generalization, showing that good representations directly drive generalization. translated_title: 预训练表示彩票决定微调泛化能力
translated_abstract: 大规模预训练（PT）后接微调（FT）是现代深度学习的核心范式，然而预训练如何塑造微调的泛化能力仍知之甚少。我们采用一个实体真实概念几何已知的合成实验设置，作为受控测试平台，研究表示几何如何影响模型行为，以及预训练表示如何决定微调泛化。我们首先发现，仅在训练随机种子上不同的模型，其预训练损失可以非常接近，但微调泛化能力却差异巨大。我们假设这一现象背后存在一种“表示彩票”：预训练期间形成的、依赖随机种子的几何结构决定了微调所能达到的水平。我们通过因果实验证实了这一点：首先，向模型注入真实概念几何可获得接近上限的微调泛化，表明良好的表示直接驱动泛化；然后，将“幸运种子”学到的表示蒸馏到另一……
tldr: 该论文提出并通过因果实验验证了“预训练表示彩票”假说：预训练阶段由随机种子决定的表示几何决定了微调泛化的上限，注入真实概念几何或蒸馏幸运种子的表示均可显著提升微调泛化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes and causally validates a "pretraining representation lottery" hypothesis: the seed-dependent representational geometry formed during pretraining determines the ceiling of fine-tuning generalization.
